reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.subtitle: Our Patients
reviews.intro: At Dental City, a dental clinic in Zapopan, patient trust is our greatest asset. These Google and Doctoralia reviews reflect the quality of our care, digital technology, and our team's commitment at every visit.
reviews.patientVideosSubtitle: Real patient experiences sharing their treatment and results at Dental City.

items.author: María G.
items.text: Excellent care from the first appointment. The digital scan was quick and the team explained every step. Very professional.

items.author: Carlos R.
items.text: I had an implant placed and the entire process was flawless. No pain, very clean office, and doctors who inspire confidence.

items.author: Ana L.
items.text: I took my daughter to Dental City Kids and it was a wonderful experience. Exceptional care for children; she now asks to go to the dentist.

items.author: Roberto M.
items.text: The best dental cleaning I've ever had. Modern facilities, punctuality, and a very friendly team. Our whole family are patients now.

items.author: Patricia S.
items.text: I had teeth whitening and the result looked natural, with no sensitivity. You can feel the attention to detail and quality of service.

items.author: Luis H.
items.text: I'm in braces and appointments are always on time. They explain everything clearly and my treatment progress exceeds my expectations.

items.a: Yes, we have pediatric dentistry and a friendly approach for children at Dental City Kids & Family.
Yes, along with payment plans for selected treatments.

items.q: What does the first visit include?
items.a: Clinical evaluation, necessary studies, and a personalized plan.
At Av. Santa Margarita 4410, Jardín Real, Zapopan, Jalisco. We serve patients from Zapopan, Guadalajara, and the metropolitan area.

items.q: What specialties and treatments do you offer?
items.a: Orthodontics (Invisalign and braces), Straumann implants, pediatric dentistry, whitening, smile design, endodontics, periodontics, maxillofacial surgery, CBCT tomography, intraoral scanning, and more.

items.q: Do you use digital dental technology?
items.a: Yes. We use 3D intraoral scanning, dental CBCT tomography, digital X-rays, and computer-assisted planning for more precise treatments.
